I will farm this sorghum the way I usually do, but I will push it a little because this is my own land and sorghum does better when I do not leave it hungry. I have seen some farmers around me get better heads with improved seed and some fertilizer, so I will use both, but not too much because cash is still tight and I still have my other plots. I will also put manure where I can, use herbicide for the first flush of weeds, and depend on rain because I do not have irrigation on this plot.
